subject: Commit clarity: normalize amounts and SKUs before Friday review
messages_1_subject: Commit clarity: normalize amounts and SKUs before Friday review
messages_1_body:
Morning team,

Quick hygiene ask ahead of Friday's commit review: finance needs our CRM normalized for any deals we plan to include in commit. I pulled the export and there are a few recurring issues — if we don't clean these up before EOD Thursday we risk overstating Q4 commit. Please update the fields below on HubSpot for deals you own (I listed owners inline).

Top issues to fix (per-deal):
- Amount vs. ARR: make sure Amount reflects ARR purchase (not TCV) and is in USD. If the customer quoted multi-year TCV, set Amount to ARR and note TCV in the notes.
- Product/SKU: map to canonical SKUs from sku_lookup_v2.xlsx (attached). Avoid free-text product names.
- Next step: one-line next step (call/demo/legal) + planned next step date.
- Probability: use our standardized bands (10/25/50/75/90) not ad-hoc percentages.

Deals I pulled that need edits (owner in parens):
- NOVA-ACQ (Olivia Chen) — owner: ben_carter — amount shows $1,200,000 (likely TCV), SKU free-text ‘Enterprise Suite’.
- ACME-EDGE (Marcus Ruiz) — owner: laura_bennett — missing next step and probability stuck at 40%.
- HSP-092 (internal POC) — owner: karthik_iyer — close date missing, SKU unclear.

Attachments: sku_lookup_v2.xlsx (canonical SKU table) and pipeline_fixes.csv (export with highlighted rows). I flagged the rows above in the CSV.

Ask: Please correct your deals in HubSpot by EOD Thursday and reply to this thread once done. If you need me to make the change (limited cases), reply with the exact change and I’ll apply it and mark it in the CSV.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

Got it — thanks for the heads up. I’ll take NOVA-ACQ and run the numbers. Two quick clarifications: 

1) For NOVA-ACQ the opportunity currently lists $1,200,000 under Amount. That was entered as 3-year TCV during initial pricing. I’ll change Amount to $400,000 ARR (annualized) and add a note with the 3-year TCV and the rationale. Fine?

2) SKU mapping: the opportunity has ‘Enterprise Suite + Onboarding’ as free text. Do you want me to map to the single canonical SKU ENT-SUITE-ANNUAL and then add a line item for professional services as a second SKU (PS-ONBOARD)? That matches sku_lookup_v2.xlsx but wanted to confirm the split.

I can push both edits by EOD today.

—Ben
